milestone: Core editor with selected M2–M5 features; remaining acceptance gates documented

galleryUI.dataset: GPT-6.1-Sol temple at five reasoning levels; other agents/prompts are placeholders

editing.snapVerified: per part: 167 of 224 catalogue parts and 5,168 of 24,735 official parts in the complete-library pack; see connectors.coverage()
editing.visibleSurfaceSelection: Depth-tested ID pass at one sample per CSS pixel
editing.rigAuthoringUI: create/edit/remove representable single-joint or pure planar vehicle rigs; preserved frames, axes, IDs, limits, motor metadata and physics settings; separate physics-settings review (masses, anchoring, friction, suspension, engine force)
editing.sourceOnlyAdmission: Source-valid projects above derived occurrence budgets retain native/LDraw backup and local recovery; derived editing, rendering and Play refuse with structured limits

inventory.resolutionList: inventory.preview returns resolution rows (part × colour: tier, mapping, candidates, colour existence, status, blocking codes); decisions via the inventory.override command with { part, decision } (choose a candidate, accept or replace a mapping, mark checked, accept colours, exclude), undoable and saved in native projects
inventory.libraryUpdate: library.updateStatus() previews which parts change when a project pinned to an older complete library is re-pinned; library.update({ expectedRevision, checkpoint? }) applies the undoable library.update command and records metadata.previousLocks

render.coverage: Opaque non-reflected non-sheared mesh instancing; instanced ordinary/conditional lines; colour variants share part geometry; transparent/reflected/sheared fallback; image parity fixtures
render.budgetApi: render.budget(): profile-driven part occurrence, variant and triangle budgets with measured use; over-budget models are refused, never partially drawn
render.lookApi: render.look.get() / render.look.set(name, controls?); render.image({ look?, lookControls? }) defaults to standard
render.lookFeatures: Procedural studio IBL shared with the path tracer (generated, no asset; `environment: "room"` for three's RoomEnvironment), soft outlines for Standard (`edges: "soft"`), tuned LDraw finishes incl. procedural glitter/speckle, depth-based GTAO, fitted soft shadows on a shadow-catcher ground, hidden outlines, PBR Neutral tone mapping, jittered still accumulation (photo); phones drop AO and vignette
render.backdropApi: render.backdrop.get() / render.backdrop.set({ name?, grid? }); name is saved in the project (scene.set command); render.image({ backdrop? }) defaults to the project's backdrop; manifest.backdrop records it

instructions.importedStepBudgetPolicy: Preserve source STEP/ROTSTEP records and defer derived instruction plans when expansion exceeds policy
instructions.generationExecution: UI dedicated worker; synchronous automation generate command
instructions.wheelWorkbenchCandidates: five pinned rim/tyre families; unique source-origin pairing and typed receiving feature; fit, deformation and fastening unknown
instructions.sceneWorkbenchCandidates: compact isolated wheel-bearing source sections; nested wheel receivers assembled on their actual parent bench; source hierarchy does not establish physical independence, detached support or safe handling
instructions.tyreReceivingViews: actual preceding bare-rim state; flexible fitting and fastening remain unverified
instructions.wheelPlacementViews: completed-wheel main views face the reviewed outward receiver axis; actual bare pin/axle views and named-host notes work without live diagram letters; camera direction does not prescribe an installation path
instructions.pictorialPdfLayout: measured blocks, complete wrapped lot labels and atomic page-sized legends; source picture/font sizes preserved; explicit long-content continuations
instructions.generatedDrawingOwnership: explicit LDCad/LSynth metadata; physical identity unverified
instructions.candidateWorkbenchProgramme: verified internal contact connectivity; external source prerequisites ordered; fit and handling unknown
instructions.destinationMarkers: approximate source body locations and explicit path endpoints in published diagrams
instructions.authoredWorkbenchProgramme: nested child/parent workbenches and root scene placements; inventory/replay validated, physical fit/handling unknown
instructions.agentWorkbench: npm run instructions:workbench -- prepare|inspect|apply|review; local pinned sources, whole-plan audits and selected real diagrams
instructions.figureDisplayProcedures: pinned narrow source families; complete ownership and unique shoulder/wrist/neck associations; atomic precedence; conditional intact supplied torso/lower body; all fitting unknown
instructions.figureWorkbenchCandidates: complete bounded source figures with no known crossing relationships; zero-new-part scene placement; physical independence and stance unverified
instructions.sourceDisplayProcedures: pinned sign, shutter and complete steering families; unique actual receiver landmarks; singleton actions, atomic ordering and isolated sign scene benches; physical fit, snapping and support remain unknown
instructions.sourceInterfaceProcedures: pinned control levers and cup/radio finite handles; unique same-parent source associations, disclosed source offsets, prior-member receiver views and conditional supplied assemblies; all fitting unknown
instructions.receiverDetailViews: optional prior receiving-member illustration; surrounding scene explicitly omitted and access unverified; never changes CAD obstacles or programme ownership
instructions.mechanismWorkbenchCandidates: finite pinned 3315/3597 hinge landmarks and five-part 2350ap01/3673/3700 held joint; preserve original prerequisites and reject outside contraction cycles; snap fit, mounting and support remain unverified
instructions.completedJointDetail: at most 64 unique available members including a current addition; editor/viewer and 240x180 publication/review illustration omit surrounding parts with explicit fit/access uncertainty; no detached module or physical turn inferred
instructions.sourceGuidedCandidates: pinned finite 48336 handle / paired 60470b clip association; complete source section and contiguous receiving run; authored hierarchy/STEP ordering prior, raw poses and strict graph unchanged
instructions.sourceGuidanceOption: instructions.generate({useSourceSteps:false}) disables authored source ordering; default enabled; fit/stability/handling remain unverified
instructions.customPartDisplayBounds: bounded project-first complete source closure; missing, ambiguous, unsupported or truncated geometry stays unknown; bounds do not infer connectors
instructions.agentRefinement: offline maintainer CLI; pinned deterministic baseline, source aliases, retained hard prerequisites and reviewed procedures, explicit agent provenance and context-bound retained checks

play.limbAnimation: minecraft-style swing, idle sway, head follow, jump/fall/fly poses

dynamicMechanisms.optIn: play.enter dynamicRigIds (UI: Play > Mechanism physics > Dynamic)
dynamicMechanisms.bodies: One rigid body per authored group; compound convex proxies per member occurrence; anchored groups keep exact triangle surfaces
dynamicMechanisms.motors: Authored position/velocity motors limited by maxEffort; animated joint targets drive motor setpoints
dynamicMechanisms.vehicles: Rapier ray-cast wheels with sprung suspension, engine force, brake and authored maxSpeed/maxSteer
dynamicMechanisms.pushing: Walking pushes loose dynamic bodies with bounded impulses; bodies never move the explorer
dynamicMechanisms.reproducibility: Identical reports for identical inputs in the pinned engine/browser; not promised across platforms

play.collision: Actual transformed triangle surfaces; capsule controller; optional session ground
play.coverage: See docs/STATUS.md and Play acceptance tests; not universal model traversability
play.movingColliderPolicy: Authored rigid-group triangle surfaces; kinematic rigs conservatively stop before touching walking or seated actor; dynamic rigs are simulated bodies that the walking actor can push
play.nearbyInteraction: E/touch authored joint toggle, remote vehicle control, and explicit authored driver-seat entry/exit

jointTargetAnimation.blockedPolicy: Keep last accepted tick pose; stop target until explicit retry
jointTargetAnimation.pausePolicy: Pause stops realtime; explicit manual ticks still advance; capture refuses mutations

vehicleWorldCollision.policy: Conservative swept chassis and wheel envelopes against complete included static and foreign-rig triangle geometry; refuse unsupported geometry or exhausted query budgets
vehicleWorldCollision.dynamicResponse: Only for rigs entered with dynamic physics

seatedVehicles.authoring: Explicit chassis-local pelvis/access/approach and 1–4 ordered standing exits; metadata review and undoable save
seatedVehicles.body: Independent compound boxes enclosing original rigid straight-leg seated visual; no mesh-derived physics
seatedVehicles.entry: Reach, access ray, supported approach, wheel-envelope clearance and swept raised transfer; refuse before mutation
seatedVehicles.driving: Conservative vehicle and rider sweeps; retain accepted poses when blocked
seatedVehicles.exit: Current-frame authored exits with real walkable support and swept transfer; blocked exit retains occupancy
seatedVehicles.scope: Supported upright unarticulated chassis/wheel rigs only; no inferred seats, low cabins, general platform riding or dynamic suspension

motors.kinematic: Position motors travel at 90 degrees/s or 40 LDU/s; velocity motors run at their target; swept actor checks block and auto-retry
motors.control: play.setMotor({rigId,jointId,enabled}); manual joint commands stop that joint's motor

automaticDoors.table: src/play/door-parts.json: hinge axis, pivot and leaf for official LDraw door leaves derived from part geometry
automaticDoors.runtime: Session-only derived kinematic rigs hinged to the part holding each door; never written to the project
automaticDoors.swing: Free direction decided by sweeping an inset leaf proxy against the Play world; two-way doors open away from the explorer
automaticDoors.control: E / on-screen Open door action, play.interact(), play.setJointTarget, CLI --open-doors; disable with autoDoors:false

trains.track: src/play/track.ts: rail centrelines of 21 official track parts (plastic, 9V, 4.5V/12V straights and R40 curves; 9V switches) pinned by their geometry
trains.runtime: Session-only trains derived from wheels on the rails; fixed-tick deterministic motion along the rail graph with bogie pivots, coupling spacing, points, end stops and explorer waiting
trains.control: Train slab (Go/Stop, speed, reverse, ride along, horn, points), play.setTrainThrottle/stopTrain/setPoints/rideTrain, CLI --train-throttle/--points/--ride-train/--no-trains; disable with trains:false

play.posedExport: play.exportPosedModel() / mechanisms.exportPosedModel() / CLI --posed-output: static posed LDraw MPD; project and rest pose unchanged

automationQueries.intersectionCandidates: bounded broad-phase only; no verified collision or connectivity claim
automationQueries.connectorCoverage: per occurrence: query({connectivity}) and connectivity.coveredIds / missingConnectorCoverageIds

sectionCut.axis: horizontal (y) or vertical (x, z), either side
sectionCut.captures: included and recorded as clipping planes in the manifest

floorGuides.detection: floor levels from top-level submodels (else layers) by geometry bounds; otherwise one ground floor

floorGuides.roomLabels: screen-facing text anchored at an LDraw point, optionally tied to a floor
floorGuides.persistence: native projects, autosave and checkpoints; omitted from LDraw/MPD export, share links and clipboard fragments
floorGuides.captures: honour floor focus and visible overlays; manifest records architecture.floorFocus and overlay counts; camera collections apply each bookmark's saved floor view

cameraCollections.api: render.collection({ prefix | names, width, height, quality?, background?, visibility? })
cameraCollections.manifest: one shared manifest per collection; one revision

connectors.pack: ldraw-derived-connectors-2 (derived from the pinned LDraw geometry at build time; CC BY 4.0 attribution; recorded in each project library lock as connectorPackId/connectorPackSha256)
connectors.completeLibraryPack: connectors-ldraw-full-2026-09-28: the same derivation and rules for every official part, 256 hash-pinned shards loaded with each part (recorded as library.full.connectorPackId/connectorPackSha256); connectors.coverage().completeLibrary

supported: hinge pin and socket (doors, window panes, door frames)
recordedNotValidated: side studs of brackets, doors and clip plates

connectors.api: connectors.coverage(), connectors.part({ ref }) (with hinge/sockets), connectors.snap({ part, position, angle? | basis?, up?, previous? }), connectors.fits({ part, position, angle? | basis?, up? }), connectors.orient({ part, point, normal, angle?, up? }), connectors.connected({ occurrenceIds }), connectors.groups(), connectors.validatePlacement({ part, position, angle? | basis? }), connectors.validateMove({ transforms })

connectedBuilding.name: Snap together
connectedBuilding.kind: UI tool setting (per device, localStorage; not document data)
connectedBuilding.rule: a placement holds when it clashes with nothing and a verified stud, side-stud, jumper or hinge connector mates, or its lowest point is on the ground (y = 0), or (only where connector data is missing on either side) it rests on a part's top; moves are refused only when the moved parts held before and would float or clash after
connectedBuilding.query: connectors.validatePlacement and connectors.validateMove return { ok, via, verified, reason, contacts, targetIds, message }

connectors.snapping: Place previews move to the nearest fit within one stud where the new part makes verified connections (anti-studs on studs, studs in anti-studs), keeping the chosen turn; tapping a face with sideways studs turns the part onto them (spun by Rotate); a door or window pane tapped onto a frame seats closed in its hinge sockets. Fits whose occupancy boxes would pass through another part are refused; otherwise bounds-based stacking
connectors.cycling: Next fit on the placement card (keys N or Tab) cycles the ranked fits; a new tap keeps the previous fit while no other is nearer by more than 6 LDU (hysteresis)
connectors.connectedSelection: Selection tools > Select connected; follows verified stud and hinge connections only
connectors.connectorWorkplane: Workplane and grid > Pick a stud: plane on the stud base, axes follow the part, grid on its stud lattice (side studs included)
connectors.verification: whole-part rules: full-underside, matched-outline, solid-base, jumper, side-studs, partial-underside, hinge-leaf (docs/CONNECTORS.md)

checks.connectivity: exact when every part has verified connectors; approximate when some parts lack them; not-verified when none have them
checks.collisions: approximate (upright catalogue parts, stud rows allowed)

checkpoints.storage: IndexedDB on this device, separate from autosave snapshots
checkpoints.compare: occurrence-level: added, removed, moved, recoloured, relayered, replaced; identity by source path

resourceProfiles.selection: automatic by device (phone-class touch screens or <=2 GB reported memory use mobile), or chosen per device

unimplemented: connector snapping beyond stud/anti-stud (clips, hinges, pins, side studs)
connected-assembly selection through parts without verified connector data
whole-library BFC conformance beyond audited fixtures
riding dynamic bodies and seated driving of dynamic vehicles
auto-rig proposals beyond official door leaves

buildScripts.cli: brick-cli build --script build.json --output build.mpd [--render view.png --views iso,front] [--target-parts N]
buildScripts.partBudget: --target-parts N / targetParts: guidance, never an error (every component copy counts); the report's target gives parts, difference and percent, costliestOps what made the most; limits.maxParts is the one hard cap (over-budget error, no model written or applied)
buildScripts.oneShot: npm run oneshot -- --target-parts N --brief "…" --model M [--efforts …]: MineBench-style runs through codex exec with no tools, the curated part list in the prompt (--parts-list) and parts search as a reply protocol (--search); invalid, overlapping or wrong-colour replies get a repair prompt with the size against the target and the errors; the distance from the target is recorded as a score; searches, finds and part knowledge are recorded
buildScripts.workspaces: npm run workspace -- --target-parts N[,N…] --brief "…": clean agent directory with the templated prompt and a ./brick-cli that reports every build against the target

partSearch.ranking: roles and builder slang, then curated, commonly produced and connector-verified parts; printed, sticker, Duplo and obsolete variants last
